rule.name: StderrAsFailure
rule.message: This treats any text on the standard error of a finished child process as a failure. Standard error also carries warnings, notices and progress: a JVM prints "Picked up JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS" whenever that variable is set, and most tools print per-file warnings while they succeed, so the check passes on one machine and fails in a container or CI image. Decide by the exit value (process.waitFor(...) or exitValue() != 0) and keep the standard error for the message. A search for a specific text in the standard error is not reported.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $errorRead := function($n) { exists($n/descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getErrorStream', 'errorReader')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Process')]]) } return //IfStatement[*[2][self::ThrowStatement or self::Block/ThrowStatement]] /*[1]/descendant-or-self::* [let $up := ancestor::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '||'])][1] return $up/self::IfStatement and ($up/*[1] is ancestor-or-self::*[parent::IfStatement][1])] [let $tested := (self::UnaryExpression[@Operator = '!']/MethodCall[@MethodName = ('isEmpty', 'isBlank')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0]/*[1], self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('>', '!=')][*[2][self::NumericLiteral][@ValueAsInt = 0]] /MethodCall[@MethodName = ('length', 'size')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0]/*[1]), $method := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression or self::Initializer][1], $names := $tested/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess/@Name return exists($tested) and empty(ancestor::IfStatement[position() > 1] [*[1][descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('waitFor', 'exitValue')] or descendant-or-self::VariableAccess[@Name = $method//VariableDeclarator [*[2]/descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('waitFor', 'exitValue')]]/VariableId/@Name]]]) and ($errorRead($tested) or exists($method//VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $names][$errorRead(*[2])]))]
